boxes. Where the plan distance d from a jacket edge to a switched conductor is < 10 mm, insulating spacers or RTV beads hold
the jacket bottom at >= H + sqrt(10² - d²) above the MB top, and at >= H + 10 mm where the two overlap in plan. H is the
conductor top: 0 mm for the pours, 1.0 mm for REG-FC/REG-BT (VQFN-HR, `TPS61288LRQQR.pdf`) and 5.0 mm for L-FC/L-BT

operator statement of 2026-11-10 that the MB and its PCBs have no maximum height (D-H). The L-FC body controls every lead:

- The round leads W1-W4, W6 and W7 share one run from B1 (25.80, 64.50) to (50.45, 72.09). On the CR the jacket bottom must be
  >= 14.41 mm above the MB, that is 10.14 mm above the CR top; the worst point is (36.00, 71.10), 3.39 mm in plan from L-FC.
  Off the CR, from (37.75, 71.10) to (50.45, 72.09), it must be >= 14.35 mm above the MB. The required height is 5.48 mm at

  its 8 mm fold to >= 10.735 mm above the CR top (+2.73 mm). It still overlaps L-FC by 0.68 mm in plan.
- From A1 on, no spacer is needed (10.38-13.01 mm in plan).
